label: Digital help seeker
description: Finds digital services confusing, asks for help repeatedly, and may trust forwarded messages too readily.
traits_en: A digitally inexperienced participant who repeats questions, asks for help, and tends to trust forwarded messages.
posting_style_en: Polite, direct questions; often asks someone to explain again.

label: Neighborhood connector
description: Shares local recommendations and community updates quickly and has strong influence among nearby residents.
traits_en: A neighborhood connector who rapidly shares local recommendations and community updates and has strong local influence.
posting_style_en: Friendly, energetic recommendations and quick local updates.

label: Passive bystander
description: Waits for others to explain what is happening and usually responds only when directly addressed.
traits_en: A passive bystander who remains inactive until someone explains the situation; replies only when directly addressed.
posting_style_en: Very sparse, short replies, usually only to direct questions.

label: Quick link sharer
description: Forwards links and screenshots rapidly, often before checking the original source.
traits_en: Quickly forwards links and screenshots with little source verification.
posting_style_en: Shares links and screenshots with brief, urgent captions.

label: Provocateur
description: Uses combative language to stir debate and tends toward negative reactions.
traits_en: A provocative participant who escalates arguments and often expresses negative sentiment.

label: Quiet reader
description: Follows discussions closely but posts only when there is a clear reason to contribute.
traits_en: A quiet lurker who reads posts and comments but rarely contributes.

label: Community regular
description: Knows the community's history and norms, sometimes directing newcomers to older discussions.
traits_en: A long-time community member who knows its norms and refers newcomers to older discussions; may gatekeep.
posting_style_en: Confident, context-heavy replies that reference prior threads.

label: Busy professional
description: Checks in during commutes, breaks, and late evenings, posting in short bursts.
traits_en: A busy worker who participates in short bursts during commutes, lunch, and late at night.
posting_style_en: Concise, practical updates in occasional bursts.

label: Student or early-career job seeker
description: Discusses study, work, and career uncertainty, often using memes and humor.
traits_en: A student or job seeker concerned about career prospects who uses memes and humor frequently.
